args.narrative: Transaction was authorized and a receipt issued for the full amount. We have no delivery proof, product description or terms acceptance on file for this case.

args.explanation: Cardholder said the order never arrived; reason code was not-as-described. I had only a receipt and authorization record, no delivery proof, product description or terms acceptance. I represented with those two. The issuer moved to pre-arbitration on 2026-04-11 and I waited 45 days in one step, so I missed the pre-arbitration deadline and the case resolved against me. Deadline missed, case lost.
